# Decentralized.Host

> Sovereign self-hosted infrastructure: replicated control plane -> signed intent -> local host admission -> execution -> signed observation -> evidence.

## Core model
Desired, admitted, executing, observed, and verified are distinct states. Unmeasured state is UNKNOWN.

## Implemented
- Ed25519 host identities and signed assignments/observations
- Local host admission policy
- BLAKE3 CAS, FastCDC, Merkle anti-entropy, snapshots, and repair
- Userspace WireGuard mesh and SWIM gossip
- Raft + mTLS control plane
- L7 edge and ACME flows
- Signed backup/restore
- 17 chaos scenarios
- Federation
- dh/v1 specification with 136 test vectors
- Independent Python conformance implementation

## Important limits
- Process runtime does not enforce CPU/memory limits; Docker runtime is used for enforced limits.
- Erasure coding is not implemented.
- gVisor and Firecracker are not wired as runtimes.
- HTTP/3 is not implemented.
- Userspace WireGuard is used rather than a kernel interface.
